name: Exterior Porch Floor RP Cleanup
intent: RP cleanup — final inspect, protection removal, furniture return (SF heuristic), customer cure-time communication, equipment cleanup.
doctrine: RP cleanup. Furniture return SF heuristic 500 SF/hr (may be separate visit after 48-72hr cure). Customer cure-time comm mandatory — written schedule, 48-72hr foot traffic, 7 day heavy furniture restriction. Felt pads under furniture legs.
